extraction.notes: AVB reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO subtotal, so affo fields are null and recurring capex is null. Q3 2023 column used (first column of Table 3). Distributions to noncontrolling interests and gain on sale of unconsolidated entities are shown as '—' (zero) for Q3 2023. Diluted shares printed as 142,198,099; entered as 142,198.099 thousands. Check: 352,955/142,198.099 = 2.48 FFO/share; 377,734/142,198.099 = 2.66 Core FFO/share. The same Table 3 also appears on seq 41 (printed 23) as an attachment; seq 12 used as the primary source. Core adjustment 'Unconsolidated entity losses (gains), net' is primarily unrealized gains on technology investments per footnote (1), categorized as investment_gain_loss. Joint venture promote, SIP loan reserve, other real estate activity, and imputed carry cost, and income tax expense were categorized as 'other' since no listed category fits well.
